about: Task 4 of the BBC Micro models plan: the copper on both faces of the Issue 7 board and its printed legend, traced from the bare scans I1 and I2 (amb5l) in the board frame of frame.json; the plan's checks on them, the component side also against I5 (8BS); and the track map. Written by board_trace.py; every figure here is a measurement made on the date of the journal entry that quotes it.

registration.folds: each chip held out in turn

againstI5.what: I5 registered to the board frame by a homography on chip pins marked by hand (marks.json i5Pins), each chip held out of the fit in turn; then the component side's copper drawn into I5's pixels through the fit to every pin, against the copper seen on I5, over the pixels where I5 shows the board (its lacquer's teal, less 0.5 mm round every edge) and I1 shows no print; intersection over union

grid.what: The traced grid: pixel (u, v)'s centre is board millimetre (originMm + ((u + 0.5) / pxPerMm, (v + 0.5) / pxPerMm))

map.choice: the highest of 8, 7 or 6 px/mm inside the budget, chosen from --look before this run
map.what: Red the component side's copper, green the solder side's, blue the print, each 255 or 0; pixel (u, v)'s centre is board millimetre (originMm + ((u + 0.5) / mapPxPerMm, (v + 0.5) / mapPxPerMm)); lossless WebP

thresholds.againstI5: the component side against I5 where I5 shows the board: intersection over union at least 0.50
thresholds.coverage: each face's copper 10 to 50 per cent of the board
thresholds.drillsInCopper: at least 95 per cent on each face
thresholds.i5Registration: I5 to the board frame on chip pins, each chip held out: median at most 1.0 mm passes, over 2.0 mm stops
thresholds.nets: at least 20 ICs; at least 90 per cent of their GND pins in one net and of their +5V pins in another; the two never connected
